Skip to main content
Poland says Russian military helicopter violated its airspace
September 23, 2026, 3:04 pm
Source: Operational Command of the Polish Armed Forces
A Russian military Mi-8 helicopter entered Polish airspace on September 23 at 11:08 a.m., the operational command of the Polish army said.
The helicopter, flying from the Kaliningrad region, crossed about 300 meters (984 feet) into Polish airspace and remained there for 42 seconds, the Polish military said.
Poland scrambled fighter jets and put ground forces and equipment on alert. “The nature of the incident indicates that Russia is once again testing the readiness of our air defense,” the command said.
Russia has not yet commented on the incident.
Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said on September 17 that Russia is planning “hybrid” strikes using missiles and drones against countries that support Ukraine. He claimed that “there is a real risk that drones or other types of missiles may fly into the territory of one or more NATO countries on the eastern flank, even cause destruction.”

Authorities in several Russian regions are turning to residents and businesses to pay for bomb shelters and protection against drone attacks, local media reported, as the country restores its civil defense infrastructure amid the war in Ukraine.
Building owners in St. Petersburg have received orders to equip shelters, while apartment residents in Yekaterinburg have been asked to approve charges for converting underground parking facilities. In Omsk, parents of kindergarten children have been asked to contribute toward supplies for a basement shelter.
The measures would shift some preparation costs to households and businesses as Russia works to restore more than 20,000 protective facilities across 82 regions, a program the Emergency Situations Ministry estimates will require about 155 billion rubles ($1.88 billion).

V Praze se ve středu konala čtrnáctá mezinárodní konference k poctě laureáta Ceny Václava Havla za lidská práva. Laureátkou za rok 2026 je íránská právnička Nasrín Sotudíová. Ta zastupovala aktivisty, novináře, příslušníky menšin i děti ohrožené trestem smrti a zároveň se zasazovala o zrušení povinného nošení hidžábu či trestu smrti. Sotudíová byla opakovaně zatčena a strávila roky ve vězení. Konference, jejímž tématem je Váha slova, nabídla právě příběhy laureátů, kteří byli vězněni, stejně jako příspěvky fundovaných odborníků. Vedle Sotudíové se akce zúčastnili například ruský učitel a autor dokumentu Pan Nikdo proti Putinovi Pavel Talankin nebo běloruská opoziční politička Maryja Kalesnikavová.

vyrez.text:
ShinyHunters: Dutch police arrest suspected member of group that claimed FBI hack - BBC News
Image source, ETIENNE LAURENT / AFP via Getty Images
By Henry Moore
Published
29 September 2026
Dutch police have arrested a suspected member of the ShinyHunters cyber-crime group that claimed to have stolen sensitive information on all FBI bureau staff - around 38,000 people.
After the alleged attack last week, the group claimed to have every agent's name, role, badge number and personal details including home address and phone numbers.
In a statement, Dutch police said it had arrested a 24-year-old man from Amsterdam on suspicion of being part of the group, which has also claimed other hacks.
The suspect was arrested on 15 September, before the alleged FBI attack. He is also suspected of attempted incitement to commit two murders, police said.
Police said they seized his devices and found a "large amount of information" on his laptop, including "details about two murders that were to be committed abroad" that they suspect he may have ordered.
The suspect has been held since his arrest. Dutch officials have not ruled out further arrests.

Russian President Vladimir Putin has ordered that the assets of German retailer Metro AG be placed under temporary administration. The move comes amid escalating tensions between Germany and Russia over the Ukraine war.
German wholesaler and food retailer Metro AG lost operational control of its Russian subsidiary on Monday after Russian President Vladimir Putin signed a decree placing the business under temporary administration. The decree put Metro Cash and Carry’s Russian operations under the management of UK Torg RUS temporarily.

The order, posted on a Russian government website on Monday, did not give a reason for the action. It follows similar moves against the Russian businesses of food company Nestlé and French retailer Auchan under a 2023 decree aimed at businesses associated with "unfriendly countries".

„Zásah byl zaznamenán v bytovém domě,“ napsal na telegramu Syněhubov s tím, že puma zničila druhé a třetí patro budovy.…

To date, the main focus in establishing a network of bomb shelters in Latvia has been on identifying and adapting the basements of existing state and local authority buildings. One of the next steps involves industrially manufactured shelters. The Ministry of Economics is currently preparing standard documentation for the procurement of such shelters, Latvian Radio reported on September 28.
Industrially manufactured shelters could be either above-ground or underground, and could be purchased by local authorities and other institutions in places where there are no suitable cellars or where adapting them would be too complicated. The Ministry of Economics (EM) has promised to draw up standardised documentation for the procurement of such shelters by the start of October.

BARENTSBURG, Norway — For the best part of a century, the biggest threat to the residents of Svalbard was polar bears. Increasingly, it now comes from Russia.
Fears are growing that Moscow could use the sprawling Arctic archipelago — a part of Norway with an unusual legal status — to test NATO militarily amid growing uncertainty over the U.S. commitment to European defense.

Rusko provedlo třetí noc po sobě dronový útok na ukrajinské hlavní město Kyjev. Útok způsobil několik požárů, nejméně jeden člověk byl zraněn, informoval server The Kyiv Independent. Nad městem operovaly jednotky protivzdušné obrany, oznámil starosta metropole Vitalij Klyčko.
Podle ukrajinského serveru, který se odvolává na úřady, byl dronový útok z noci na neděli třetím dnem útoků na ukrajinskou metropoli po sobě. Místní zpravodajové serveru ve městě slyšeli zasahovat protivzdušnou obranu. Při útoku byla zraněna žena, které se ujali zdravotníci, informovala ukrajinská služba pro mimořádné situace.
V Ševčenkivské čtvrti podle Klyčka dron zasáhl obytnou budovu, která však byla neobydlená. Její požár dostali hasiči pod kontrolu.
V Solomjanské čtvrti dopadl dron na volné prostranství. Tlaková vlna však poškodila…

Aftermath of a drone attack near the Ukrainian-Moldovan border Image: OdeskaODA/Telegram Advertisement
Just a few months ago, Russia's war was an distant reality for many people in Europe outside of Ukraine. If Russian drones occasionally entered the airspace of countries like Poland or Romania, even official statements seemed strangely dismissive and abstract. Even after a Russian drone struck a high-rise apartment building in the eastern Romanian city of Galati in late May this year, many EU and NATO representatives hesitated to accuse Russia of intentional action. At most, there was discussion of hybrid warfare.
The situation has changed radically since the summer. Ukrajinská armáda vyvinula nový pozemní robotický systém Desantnyk (Výsadkář). Roboty dostávají do týla nepřítele za použití tzv. „vačnatce“, kdy bombardovací drony shazují malá bojová vozítka na nepřátelské území. Systém vyvinula zbrojařská iniciativa Brave1, uvedl server Ukrainska Pravda.
Nový ukrajinský robotický systém Desantnyk Video: Brave1
Článek
Robotický systém vytvořili příslušníci pluku Alter Ego z 93. samostatné mechanizované brigády. Technologie umožňuje vysadit pozemního robota desítky kilometrů za nepřátelskou linii pomocí bezpilotního letounu.
„Systém, ve kterém jeden dron dopravuje druhý do oblasti operací, se nazývá „marsupial“ (česky vačnatec). Podobná řešení vyvíjeli před třiceti lety ve Spojených státech, nikdy je ale nevyužili v boji,“ cituje server iniciativu Brave1.
Kromě samotného Desantnyku iniciativa vyvinula také řešení, jak je přesně svrhnout z bombardovacího dronu. Podle Brave1 od nápadu…

The arson attack took place in Munich on Sept. 3, when several incendiary devices were thrown from a passing car onto a construction site near the headquarters of Rohde & Schwarz and Helsing.
No one was injured in the incident. The damage was minor, and the fire was quickly extinguished.

Vojak cez známych verboval záujemcov o útek z Ukrajiny a civilista ich viedol na nelegálny prechod na Slovensko. Polícia ich prichytila pri preberaní platby.
Vojak a civilista, ktorí boli súčasťou organizovanej skupiny, zabezpečovali nelegálny prechod osôb podliehajúcich vojenskej povinnosti z Ukrajiny na Slovensko, informovala v piatok ukrajinská generálna prokuratúra. Zároveň dodala, že za túto „službu“ si pýtali 8500 amerických dolárov (v prepočte 7450 eur), píše TASR.
Orgány v rámci vyšetrovania zistili, že vojak prostredníctvom blízkych osôb vyhľadával záujemcov o nelegálne prekročenie hranice. Jeho komplic ich mal zase dopraviť na vopred určené miesto v…
